newsitem.title: USA: Clinton seeks $300 million additional disaster aid.
newsitem.headline: Clinton seeks $300 million additional disaster aid.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has asked Congress for an additional $300 million in disaster aid for the flood-ravaged states of North Dakota, South Dakota and Minnesota, the White House said Thursday.

The White House said in a statement the money brings to $788 million the total amount that Clinton and Congress are seeking for the region, which the president visited on Tuesday to see the damage wrought by heavy flooding.

The total includes $288 million Clinton already requested, $200 million that House of Representatives subcommittees have added to this, $200 million that Clinton said he would seek when he visited the area and a new $100 million request for community reconstruction and economic development.
